eyebrow: Lesson 05 · B1 · Good Manners at School · 20 câu
heading: Ready to Learn
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Good Manners at School – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 4–7.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Good Manners at School (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: Imagine a classroom where nobody raised their hand. Every time the teacher asked a question, thirty students would shout their answers {at once|at once}. It would be far too noisy to think! Raising your hand and waiting until the teacher calls your name may seem like a small thing, but it shows {respect|respect} for your teacher and your classmates.

paras.label: B
paras.text: You spend a large part of each day at school, {surrounded by|surrounded by} many other students. When everyone uses good manners, it becomes easier for all of you to learn and have fun together.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Good manners start before the lesson even begins: arrive on time. When a student comes in late, the whole class is {interrupted|interrupted}. The door opens, chairs scrape, the teacher may stop to talk to the {latecomer|latecomer}, and the others lose their {concentration|concentration}. If you are ever late, a simple "I'm sorry I'm late" {goes a long way|goes a long way}.

paras.label: D
paras.text: Polite words are just as important in class as anywhere else. Use "please" and "thank you", and if you need a pencil, ask to {borrow|borrow} one instead of {grabbing|grabbing} it from someone's desk. Interestingly, in China students actually take lessons in manners at school, learning things like table manners and how to stand in line.

paras.label: E
paras.text: Finally, be {patient|patient}. When the teacher explains a project, listen to all the {directions|directions} before you start. If you rush in too early, you might end up with a big mess!

parts.title: Part 1 · Matching headings
parts.instr: Chọn tiêu đề phù hợp nhất cho mỗi đoạn. Có 2 tiêu đề thừa.
options: Why hands go up before answers
How to finish a project quickly
Ways to make the teacher laugh

items.label: Paragraph A
items.why: Đoạn A: giơ tay thay vì hét câu trả lời.

items.label: Paragraph B
items.why: Đoạn B: nhiều học sinh cùng học, cùng vui.

items.label: Paragraph C
items.why: Đoạn C: đến muộn làm cả lớp gián đoạn.

items.label: Paragraph D
items.why: Đoạn D: hỏi mượn bút, không giật lấy.

items.label: Paragraph E
items.why: Đoạn E: nghe hết hướng dẫn rồi mới làm. Tiêu đề *finish quickly* là bẫy.

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: According to paragraph A, what would happen if nobody raised their hand?
options: The classroom would be too noisy to think.
The teacher would ask fewer questions.
questions.why: *It would be far too noisy to think!*

questions.q: The writer says arriving late only affects the student who is late.
Which of these is NOT mentioned as a result of arriving late?
options: The late student has to stay after school.
The door and chairs make noise.
questions.why: Bài không nhắc việc phải ở lại sau giờ học.

questions.q: Why does the writer mention China?
options: Students there study manners at school.
questions.why: *…in China students actually take lessons in manners at school.*

questions.q: The writer thinks you should ask before using a classmate's pencil.
questions.why: Đúng. *ask to borrow one instead of grabbing it.*

questions.q: According to paragraph E, what might happen if you start a project before the teacher finishes explaining?
options: You might make a big mess.
You might finish first and win a prize.
The teacher might give you extra time.
questions.why: *you might end up with a big mess!*

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: What is the boy doing right?
options: He is raising his hand and waiting to be called.
questions.why: Đúng lời khuyên đoạn A: giơ tay, chờ thầy cô gọi tên.
questions.alt: A boy at his desk with his hand raised; a girl sits quietly next to him

questions.q: According to paragraph C, what should this boy say?
questions.why: *a simple "I'm sorry I'm late" goes a long way.*
questions.alt: A teacher pointing at the clock as a boy runs into the classroom

questions.q: Why is the teacher pointing at the clock?
options: to show that the boy has arrived late
to start a new lesson about time
to tell the class it is lunchtime
questions.why: Cô chỉ đồng hồ khi cậu bé chạy vào → nhắc cậu đã đến muộn.
questions.alt: A teacher pointing at the clock as a boy runs into the classroom

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: Nam was always the first to finish his work, but he often got low marks. [1] One day, the teacher gave instructions for a science poster. [2] When he finished, his poster was exactly what the teacher wanted. [3]
options: This was because he never listened to the whole set of instructions.
This time, Nam waited until she had finished explaining before he started.
He realised that being patient was more important than being fast.
As usual, he grabbed a pencil from his friend's desk.
He started cutting paper before she had said a word.

items.why: Giải thích vì sao Nam hay bị điểm thấp: không nghe hết hướng dẫn.
*This time* → lần này khác: Nam chờ cô giảng xong. Phương án *started cutting paper* mâu thuẫn với kết quả tốt.
Rút ra bài học: kiên nhẫn quan trọng hơn nhanh.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *…thirty students would shout their answers at once* (A). **At once** here means…
questions.why: **At once** ở đây = cùng một lúc.

questions.q: *…a simple "I'm sorry I'm late" goes a long way* (C). This means it…
options: takes a long time to say
questions.why: **Go a long way** = có tác dụng lớn.

questions.q: *…instead of grabbing it from someone's desk* (D). To **grab** something is to…
